 governor 
 GOP Sen. Susan Collins is running for a sixth term and is the only Republican representing a state President Donald Trump lost in 2024. Former Senate President Democrat Troy Jackson is her opponent, a staunch progressive replacing former nominee Graham Platner who dropped out after allegations of sexual assault which he denies. If no candidate wins a majority of the vote, the winner will be decided by ranker-choice voting.
